notes: Fair and solvable: seven constraints, each decoy fails exactly one, and the dialogue gives every one a clear line.
The budget clue ('middle shelf', 'top shelf is for people with yachts') is metaphorical but readable. With Wavecrest the only $$$ venue, it is easy once you check the cards.

Sampan's vegetarian evidence hedges a little ('on our visit not one basket on it held meat or seafood'), and the first review lists pork siu mai and har gow. A careful player could wonder if the veg range is reliable. It is still clearly enough, but it is softer than Lighthouse Row's or Capstan's explicit meatless sections.
Mina's line says 'would make my day', so I read vegetarian as a preference rather than a strict diet. The pick is the same either way.
Distractor lines (the hat, the voice notes, the basement glow) do not hide any constraints. No contradictions found.
